card.name: Verb after drug name in overdose text
card.fires_on: The verb or linking word right after a drug name as the subject, mostly in overdose sections, such as 'is' before 'not removed by dialysis'. Also 'soluble', 'bound' and 'not' in similar drug-property sentences.

modes.label: is after drug name
modes.description: The word 'is' following a drug name in an overdose passage about dialysis or removal.
modes.example: Pantoprazole<< is>> not removed by hemodialysis. In

modes.label: Property words
modes.description: Words like soluble, bound or not that state a drug's property after the drug name.
modes.example: Brimonidine tartrate appears as a pale yellow colored powder to wheatish colored powder and is<< soluble>> in water at pH 7.4

modes.label: Non-drug subject
modes.description: Verb after a plural subject in a biography sentence.
modes.example: Virtanen married Lilja Moisio in 1920; they<< have>> two sons, Kaarlo and Olavi

card.plain: It fires on the verb that comes right after a drug's name when the text goes on to describe the drug, such as whether dialysis removes it.
